description: This file implements the core logic of a text-based Word Guess game, including game state management, user interactions, and game flow control. It defines the Game struct, associated methods, and a PlayGame function to run the game loop.

classes.name: Game
classes.description: Represents the current state of a word guessing game, including the word to guess, guessed letters, number of incorrect guesses, and game status flags.

methods.name: NewGame
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new game instance with a randomly selected word from the WordList.

methods.name: GuessLetter
methods.description: Processes a player's letter guess, updates the game state, and determines if the game has been won or lost.

methods.name: GetRemainingLetters
methods.description: Returns a string of letters that have not yet been guessed.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Produces a formatted string representing the current game display, including the word, guesses, and game status.
